title: Partnerships
slide_intent: Teach how to share a line between unequal marks while preserving each partner’s legibility.
strategic_value: Using a spacing unit from Instacart’s own name can make partner lockups consistent across varying logo shapes.
demonstration: Three diagrams show a single partner, multiple partners and a Powered by treatment. The text defines the gap with the width of the c and calls for optically balanced scale.
practical_value: Use c-width gaps, then adjust the heights by eye when partner symbols have different proportions.
